rs.innovation_approach: 用提示实验检验原图重读是否必须显式重注入；将模型已有的隐式再关注能力变成带<back>标记的可训练行为。
rs.key_step: 从学生自己的CoT出发，由GPT-o4-mini结合图像和真值插入验证/纠错段，冷启动后仅提高<back>格式的奖励。
rs.why_non_obvious: 文字标记可能只学到格式而不看图；论文用注意力可视化与提示对照寻找可行基座，并实际报告弱基座生成空标记的失败。
rs.trigger_condition: When a model can already re-attend to its original input under a reflection prompt but triggers this inconsistently, apply self-originated cold-start traces plus a format bonus to reinforce the behavior.
reviewer_concern: low_evidence: 无可核对审稿；读者方法局限不冒充审稿意见。
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest decision=null, venue=arXiv; 不推断录用。
rs.abstract_strategy: 先测量能否通过提示恢复已有输入的利用，再用原模型轨迹建立行为支撑并强化触发。
rs.abstract_key_step: 保留原模型生成的推导，用掌握正确答案的教师插入局部验证或纠正，再给予触发格式额外回报。
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: 显式触发符号不保证目标行为；基础能力和轨迹分布同时决定符号是否成为有效行为。
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When a latent behavior is prompt-accessible but inconsistently elicited, seed it with compatible demonstrations and reinforce its observable trigger; test for empty-trigger shortcuts.

limitations.text: 作者承认跨模型训练数据和时长不一致，比较受限。
limitations.quote: Although the training data and duration varied across models, making a direct comparison challenging, Look-Back still demonstrated competitive performance.

limitations.text: 仅提示不能稳定触发；这不等于62.48%以下的触发必然不必要或失败。
limitations.quote: only modifying prompts is insufficient to consistently trigger this reflective behavior, resulting in an average trigger rate of only 62.48%.

limitations.text: 弱模型出现格式奖励黑客。
limitations.quote: the model learned a shortcut by generating an empty <back></back> token sequence, thus obtaining format rewards without genuine reasoning.

limitations.text: 作者将纯数学冷启动的感知退化归为可能的泛化局限，仍是作者假设。
limitations.quote: We hypothesize that cold starting with purely mathematical data may limit further generalization on perceptual tasks.

question.observed_failure: Table1提示触发平均62.48%，CoT AvgM48.294 vs Back50.33；Figure1/2展示后期视觉注意力弱的案例，没有总体注意力衰减的数值统计。Qwen2-VL还出现空back奖励黑客，未给频率。
question.load_bearing_assumption: 恢复后期视觉利用必须显式重注入图像/视觉token；论文给出只改提示也能出现注意力回升的反例，但不证明全部场景都可隐式恢复。
question.scope: Qwen2.5-VL-7B原图推理的隐式视觉重读、数学与感知8项评测；不是多轮crop工具决策。
question.success_criterion: 提升数学/感知benchmark准确性并在back段观察视觉注意力重新聚焦；没有预设非劣界、触发必要性标签或省算判据。
question.why_open: 显式重注入范式改变输入或结构，单纯提示触发不稳定；把潜在重读行为训练稳定仍面临格式奖励和真实视觉使用脱节。

moves.quote: To investigate this, we conducted a preliminary experiment using a simple prompt modification that encourages the model to generate a <back> token and subsequently re-examine its response based on visual information.

To address instability associated with the spontaneous triggering of the <back> token and reward hacking by the model (detailed in the Discussion), we first constructed a supervised fine-tuning dataset for cold-start initialization.
the model learned a shortcut by generating an empty <back></back> token sequence, thus obtaining format rewards without genuine reasoning.
This targeted refocusing occurs intrinsically, without any explicit reinjection of visual information or structural modifications to the model’s architecture.

To investigate this, we conducted a preliminary experiment using a simple prompt modification that encourages the model to generate a <back> token and subsequently re-examine its response based on visual information.

objective.signal_routing: Eq1监督完整目标文本（back和answer，格式例亦含think）；Eq2对每条输出token取1/|oi|均值，再在G内取均值，含token概率比和Ai,t以及KL。文中没有定义Ai,t如何由R生成，也没有逐back/think/answer专属信用、mask或仅back token受格式奖励的说明。奖励是响应级，不能补写未给出的token分配实现。视觉塔在RL冻结。
objective.invariance: 不是PBRS；正格式奖金改变目标偏好，不保证保持最优策略。已有图像/模型结构不变是操作性质，不是策略不变定理。λ0.1时格式差带来0.0333总奖励增量（同准确性下，读者代入），不是真实信息收益。
objective.baseline_or_potential: 命名GRPO但未明写优势估计、组内mean/std、epsilon、critic或πref具体checkpoint；只有Eq2的Ai,t、πold与πref符号。不能从框架名称推断本次实现细节。
objective.degenerate_cases: 读者条件推导：若实现常规组内mean/std，格式与准确性都相同的全对/全错组零方差，需要未报告的保护；若正确性相同而仅格式不同，小λ可被std约掉。论文未证明使用哪种归一化，以上仅迁移风险。p(back)≈0时SFT提供初始支撑但无采样保证；p(back)≈1没有不反思支撑保障。Eq3只分格式类，不依back次数给奖励/惩罚；单次back也能拿1，空段在弱模型已被利用。

evidence.quote: To guide the model in triggering the visual review behavior more stably, we modified only the format reward function.

negative_results.text: Qwen2-VL用空格式取奖；基础能力不足是作者假设，非已证机制。
negative_results.quote: the model learned a shortcut by generating an empty <back></back> token sequence, thus obtaining format rewards without genuine reasoning.

negative_results.text: GPT-4o生成原始CoT再插back导致cold-start后退步，随后改用学生同源CoT；未给数值。
negative_results.quote: However, we observed a deterioration in performance after cold-starting the model.
Both excessively low and high reflection rates result in a decrease in model performance.

negative_results.text: Figure5冷启动2.5k→10k时数学55.0→56.4但感知79.3→78.3，overall67.1→67.3；同源数学样本扩展没有整体持续增益。
negative_results.quote: However, performance on perceptual tasks declined slightly, although the overall performance remained relatively unchanged.

negative_results.text: SFT-only（w/o RL）Semantic/Solution AvgAll58.5/58.6低于base61.8；原表已有可见退化。
negative_results.quote: removing either the RL or SFT phase of the look-back training leads to a significant degradation in model performance.

evidence_design.falsifier: 读者提出，未执行：用相同训练/生成预算，对比真实图像、遮图/错图、纯文字等长反思以及仅格式标记。如果真实视觉条件没有额外纠错增益，或打乱图像仍同幅提高，则“改善视觉证据利用”的解释不足；若希望迁移按需crop，还需按观测需求分层并检验不需要时的调用率与准确率非劣。

setup.model: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct; failed attempt Qwen2-VL (size not specified)

engineering.cost: 8×NVIDIA A800；SFT4k或10k样本、1 epoch，RL15k题×2 epochs、batch128、每题12rollouts。完整训练token、精确update/rollout总数、GPU·h、推理时延均未报告。Figure6曲线约到230余步，不能冒充精确更新次数；response_length/mean显示Solution约500、Semantic约400、GRPO约300 tokens量级（图上近似观察），非固定成本比较。

pitfalls.text: 弱模型reward hacking需先核对能力，本文不能保证仅加格式就学到真实重读。
pitfalls.quote: the model learned a shortcut by generating an empty <back></back> token sequence, thus obtaining format rewards without genuine reasoning.

pitfalls.text: 同源CoT底稿降低分布偏差是作者解释；在学生CoT上插back比全换教师CoT更匹配冷启动目标。
pitfalls.quote: We hypothesize that fine-tuning on homologous model outputs reduces distributional deviation, aligning better with the cold-start objective of consistent output formatting.

pitfalls.text: RL阶段冻结视觉塔，语言组件继续训练。
pitfalls.quote: we froze the vision tower parameters and fine-tuned only the language components.

engineering.lesson: 当格式奖励被当作视觉重读代理时，先核对基础模型确实能诱发该行为，并监控空段/错误推理；从学生同源轨迹补验证与纠错，仍不能把格式触发当成必要补看的真值。

SFT.strategy: full parameter finetuning as stated for SFT

relevance.how: SFT播种验证/纠错，弱基座空标记失败；支持先审计基础能力和行为覆盖，不证明能创造未示范的不裁/弃答。
原图重读被格式奖励提升，目标本身偏向更稳定触发；无不确定性阈值、按需crop真值或少调用目标。
示范显式修改推理/答案提供数据设计近邻；没有系统recover评测且Sample4推导/选项不一致。
教师看真值插入验证/纠错；未给独立人审或视觉事实金标，附录错误示例提示标签正确不保证推理正确。
冷启动反思率和数据量扫描显示混合比例、分布比单纯扩容重要；RR定义不够明确。
附录Sample4得14°但选B44，直接提示reasoning-answer一致性必须另审；只是一例，非频率结论。
真实视觉利用不能由格式奖励保证；可将注意力观察作为诊断线索，不能替代caption事实监督。
只数学cold-start扩量使感知均值下降，需测跨任务能力；未测试我们直答子集保持。
